performance.verdict: CPL win is real, but pipeline is dark — leads aren't becoming cases.

findings.text: CPL dropped 36% to ~$20.88 (28d avg) while leads surged 182% in 7d — efficiency win is confirmed against this client's own $45 CPL ceiling.
⛔ Extension with Marwan unsigned since 2026-08-31; engagement is month-to-month lapsed, gating the next 3-month term and all scale decisions.
⛔ SMS automation and Zoho Voice access both overdue since 2026-08-31; contact rate is the stated bottleneck and these two blockers directly suppress it.
GHL shows 68 contacts vs 86 Meta leads (28d) — 18-lead gap with 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments; leads arriving but intake pipeline is empty, this is an intake leak not an ads problem.
GBP actions fell 56.52% week-over-week (3-day tail: 0, 0, 0) while paid leads are surging — organic channel has gone dark, likely an access or posting lapse.

suggestions.text: Fix GHL intake leak: reconcile 18 missing leads and audit opportunity-creation workflow before next lead volume increase.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta delivered 86 leads over 28 days but GHL shows only 68 contacts and zero opportunities created, meaning at least 18 leads are unaccounted for in the pipeline. Andrew should audit the GHL-to-Zoho handoff and confirm every lead form submission is creating a contact and triggering an opportunity. Success is confirmed when GHL contacts ≥ Meta leads reported (within 5%) and at least one opportunity stage is populated. Complete by 2026-09-27.

suggestions.text: Watch 'Leads - August Re-Launch' CPL daily; hold budget at $79/day until Marwan extension is signed and intake leak is fixed.
suggestions.monday_update: CPL is at a strong $20.88 (28d) and leads are up 182% — scaling is defensible on efficiency alone, but two blockers prevent it: the Marwan extension is unsigned (lapsed since 2026-08-31) and 18 leads are untracked in GHL with zero pipeline movement. Hold daily spend at ~$79/day and re-check on 2026-09-27. Scale is approved the moment both the extension is signed and GHL opportunities show intake is working.

suggestions.text: Chase Zoho Voice access and SMS automation go-live to unblock contact rate — the stated case-volume bottleneck since 2026-08-31.
suggestions.monday_update: SMS automation and Zoho Voice access have both been overdue since 2026-08-31. Marwan's measure is cost-per-signed-case, not CPL — and contact rate is the confirmed bottleneck between a lead and a signed case. Nacer should escalate to Joy or Andrew for access credentials this week. Success is confirmed when SMS sequences are firing on new GHL contacts and Zoho Voice is active; re-check 2026-09-27.
